```{r}
do_kegg_for_sheet <- function(gene_vec, sheet_name = NULL) {

  ## Remove NA and empty strings
  gene_vec <- unique(trimws(as.character(gene_vec)))
  gene_vec <- gene_vec[!is.na(gene_vec) & gene_vec != ""]

  ## Skip if no genes
  if (length(gene_vec) == 0) {
    message("SKIPPING: No genes for sheet ", sheet_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## Convert SYMBOL -> ENTREZID safely
  genes <- tryCatch(
    bitr(
      gene_vec,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("SKIPPING: No valid gene symbols for sheet ", sheet_name)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(genes)) 
    return(NULL)

  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes$ENTREZID), ]

  if (nrow(genes) == 0) {
    message("SKIPPING: No genes mapped for sheet ", sheet_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  kegg_gsa <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = genes$ENTREZID,
    organism = "mmu",
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05
  )

  if (is.null(kegg_gsa) || 
      is.null(kegg_gsa@result) || 
      nrow(kegg_gsa@result) == 0) {
    message("SKIPPING: KEGG returned no enriched pathways for sheet ", sheet_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  kegg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_gsa@result)
  sig_end_common_up <- subset(kegg_df, p.adjust < 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig_end_common_up) == 0) {
    sig_end_common_up$gene_symbols <- character(0)
  } else {
    all_entrez <- unique(unlist(strsplit(sig_end_common_up$geneID, "/")))

    id_map <- bitr(
      all_entrez,
      fromType = "ENTREZID",
      toType = "SYMBOL",
      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
    )

    entrez2symbol <- setNames(id_map$SYMBOL, id_map$ENTREZID)

    sig_end_common_up$gene_symbols <- sapply(
      sig_end_common_up$geneID,
      function(x) {
        ids <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
        paste(na.omit(entrez2symbol[ids]), collapse = "/")
      }
    )
  }

  # Return a list containing both the enrichment object and the filtered data frame
  return(list(
    gsa_obj = kegg_gsa,
    sig_df  = sig_end_common_up
  ))
}

convert_core_enrichment <- function(entrez_string) {
  if (is.na(entrez_string) || entrez_string == "") return(NA)
  
  entrez_ids <- strsplit(entrez_string, "/")[[1]]
  
  # mapIds preserves vector order and size
  symbols <- suppressMessages(
    mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, 
           keys = entrez_ids, 
           column = "SYMBOL", 
           keytype = "ENTREZID", 
           multiVals = "first")
  )
  
  # Fallback: keep original Entrez ID if Symbol is missing
  symbols <- ifelse(is.na(symbols), entrez_ids, symbols)
  paste(symbols, collapse = "/")
}
```


#data loading
```{r}
set.seed(6335)
excel_path <- "~/data/spatial_only_degs.xlsx"
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(excel_path)
results_list <- list()
for (sheet in sheet_names) {
  message("Processing sheet: ", sheet)
  end_common_up <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = sheet)
  symbols <- as.vector(end_common_up$Gene_Name)
  res <- do_kegg_for_sheet(symbols, sheet_name = sheet)
  if(!is.null(res)) results_list[[sheet]] <- res
}
#write.xlsx(results_list, file = "GSEA_unici.xlsx")
```

#Extracting info for barplot
```{r}
extract_pathway_degs <- function(pathway_description, target) {
  
  gsea_df <- results_list[[target]]$sig_df
  gene_symbols <- gsea_df$gene_symbols[gsea_df$Description == pathway_description]
  gene_vector <- unlist(strsplit(gene_symbols[1], "/"))
  
  top_df <- logfc_file
  
  res_df <- data.frame(
    Gene  = gene_vector,
    logFC = top_df[top_df$gene %in% gene_vector, "logFC"],
    fdr   = top_df[top_df$gene %in% gene_vector, "FDR"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(res_df)
}
```

#barplot PER LOGFC NEGATIVI
```{r}
plot_deg_bar_neg <- function(data, filename = "deg_analysis_prot.png", width = 8, height = 12, dpi = 300) {
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(Gene, -logFC), y = logFC, fill = FDR)) + #ATT AL SEGNO DI LOGFC DA CAMBIARE
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#1f77b4",   # Colore scuro per FDR più bassi (più significativi)
      high = "#aec7e8",  # Colore chiaro per FDR più alti
      name = "Adjusted p-value"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    labs(
      title = "Differentially Expressed Genes",
      x = "Gene Symbol",
      y = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change")
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  # Salva il grafico su file
  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi
  )
  
  # Restituisce l'oggetto ggplot in modo da poterlo mostrare o personalizzare ulteriormente
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}

p <- plot_deg_bar_neg(deg_data_rel, "logFC_myo_down_relaxin.png")
p <- plot_deg_bar_neg(deg_data_wnt, "logFC_myo_down_wnt.png")
```

```{r}
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi

}
```

#heatmap preparation
```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/data/bin16_list_ann.rds")
c26_sham_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in% c("sham_b1","c26_b2","sham_b3","c26_b4","sham_b6","c26_b6")]

#seleziona solo myo
myo_types <- c("Myonuclei_IIb", "Myonuclei_IIx", "Myonuclei_IIx_IIa","Myonuclei_IIx_IIb", "Myonuclei_MTJ",
                                      "Myonuclei_NMJ", "Myonuclei_Trim63")
c26_sham_list <- lapply(c26_sham_list, function(spe) {
  spe <- spe[, spe$cell_type %in% myo_types]
  spe$cell_type <- droplevels(spe$cell_type)
  return(spe)
})
```

#heatmap function
```{r}
plot_gene_heatmaps_pdf <- function(lista_geni, spe_list, filename = "heatmaps.pdf", width = 8, height = 10) {
  
  # Se viene passato un singolo vettore invece di una lista, viene convertito in lista
  if (!is.list(lista_geni)) {
    lista_geni <- list(Geni = lista_geni)
  }
  
  # Assegna nomi generici se la lista non è nominata
  if (is.null(names(lista_geni))) {
    names(lista_geni) <- paste("Set", seq_along(lista_geni))
  }
  
  # Apre il device PDF
  pdf(filename, width = width, height = height)
  
  for (nome_set in names(lista_geni)) {
    geni <- lista_geni[[nome_set]]
    
    # 1. Estrazione e calcolo delle medie per tessuto
    lista_matrici <- lapply(spe_list, function(spe) {
      # Controllo di sicurezza: prende solo i geni effettivamente presenti nell'oggetto
      geni_validi <- intersect(geni, rownames(spe))
      if (length(geni_validi) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      somme <- rowSums(counts(spe)[geni_validi, , drop = FALSE])
      df <- as.data.frame(t(somme))
      df$tissue_type <- unique(spe$tissue_type)
      return(df)
    })
    
    # Rimuove eventuali elementi NULL
    lista_matrici <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lista_matrici)
    
    if (length(lista_matrici) == 0) {
      warning(paste("Nessun gene trovato per il set:", nome_set))
      next
    }
    
    # 2. Aggregazione dei dati
    df_totale <- do.call(rbind, lista_matrici)
    tabella_finale <- aggregate(. ~ tissue_type, data = df_totale, FUN = mean)
    
    matrice_heatmap <- as.matrix(tabella_finale[, -1])
    rownames(matrice_heatmap) <- tabella_finale$tissue_type
    
    # 3. Generazione dell'heatmap (una pagina per ciascun set di geni)
    pheatmap(
      t(matrice_heatmap),
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      display_numbers = FALSE,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
      main = paste("Heatmap Espressione -", nome_set)
    )
  }
  
  # Chiude e salva il file PDF
  dev.off()
  message("Grafici salvati con successo in: ", filename)
}
```

#plot with up and down together
```{r}
combined_res <- gsea_myo_up
raw_combined <- rbind(gsea_myo_up@result, gsea_myo_down@result)

#Rimuovi righe duplicate mantenendo la più significativa (p.adjust minore)
raw_combined <- raw_combined[order(raw_combined$p.adjust), ]
combined_res@result <- raw_combined[!duplicated(raw_combined$ID), ]

p <- enrichplot::dotplot(combined_res, showCategory = 50, font.size = 8,
                    title = "Enriched Pathways")
ggsave("pathways_myo_combined_unique.pdf", plot = p,
       width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
